ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..original: Uwah, my head is starting to hurt... Lydie, what does this mean?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..translation: Ух, голова начинает болеть... Лиди, что это значит?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..original: Let's have a look. You need to add them while mixing...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..translation: Давай посмотрим. Их нужно добавлять во время смешивания...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..original: Hey, look at this! Studying hard even on your own. That's the way, girls!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..translation: Эй, посмотрите-ка! Даже самостоятельно усердно учитесь. Вот так, девочки!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..original: Ah, Ilmeria! We've been waiting for you!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..translation: Ах, Ильмерия! Мы тебя ждали!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..original: Oh, you have? Do you have a question for me?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..translation: О, правда? У вас есть ко мне вопрос?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..original: I'm tired of studying... Let's have some fun!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..translation: Я устала учиться... Давайте повеселимся!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..original: That's brave of you, Sue. To say that right after I just praised your diligence.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..translation: Смело с твоей стороны, Сью. Сказать это сразу после того, как я только что похвалила ваше усердие.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..original: But all this reading wears me out! I really need a break!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..translation: Но от всего этого чтения я выматываюсь! Мне правда нужен перерыв!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..original: Hahaha, I'm sorry... Sorry Sue is such a bad student...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..translation: Ха-ха-ха, прости... Прости, что Сью такая плохая ученица...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..original: Hah, I guess it can't be helped. I was going to give you these later, but here's some sweets.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..translation: Ха, ничего не поделаешь. Я собиралась дать вам это позже, но вот сладости.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..original: Ah! Are you sure? These are expensive!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..translation: Ах! Ты уверена? Они же дорогие!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..original: Are they? Don't worry about the cost, just eat them.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..translation: Так ли это? Не беспокойтесь о цене, просто ешьте.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..original: Great! I love you! Let's eat!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..translation: Отлично! Люблю тебя! Давайте есть!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..original: Thank you so much for that!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..translation: Большое спасибо!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..original: Wow, they were really good. So rich, but then they just melt in the mouth!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..translation: Ого, они правда вкусные. Такие насыщенные, а потом просто тают во рту!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..original: I think you ate a few too many, though, Sue. Keep that up and you'll become fat!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..translation: Но ты, кажется, съела слишком много, Сью. Продолжай так — и растолстеешь!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..original: I needed sugar after using my head so much! I watch my weight, don't worry about me!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..translation: Мне нужен был сахар после такой умственной нагрузки! Я слежу за весом, не беспокойся!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..original: I'm still growing, too! Everything I eat makes me taller, not wider!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..translation: Я ещё расту! Всё, что я ем, идёт в рост, а не в ширину!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..original: ...ugh.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..original: What, really? We might be twins, but I'm taller! Are you sure you aren't getting wider?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..translation: Что, правда? Мы близняшки, но я выше! Ты уверена, что не растёшь вширь?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..original: N-No I'm not! You're taller by, what, a centimeter? Maybe?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..translation: Н-ничего подобного! Ты выше меня ну максимум на сантиметр! И то вряд ли!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..original: That doesn't even count. I'm growing every day! I might even overtake you soon!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..translation: Это даже не считается. Я расту каждый день! Скоро я тебя обгоню!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..original: ...Uuuuh!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..translation: ...Уууу!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..original: Um, Ilmeria? You've been moaning and groaning to yourself over there for a while now...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..translation: Эм, Ильмерия? Ты уже какое-то время там стонешь себе под нос...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..original: It must be nice, to have such hope for the future. I've done all the growing... all the growing I'm...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..translation: Должно быть, приятно... возлагать такие надежды на будущее. А я вот уже отросла своё... Мой рост уже...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..original: Oh... Don't tell me, you've got a bit of a complex about your height?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..translation: Ох... Только не говори, что у тебя комплекс насчёт роста?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..original: Hahaha... I don't think we should bring up height around her...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..translation: Ха-ха-ха... Думаю, при ней лучше не поднимать тему роста...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..original: What now, then, Lydie? It's about to explode...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..translation: И что теперь, Лиди? Он вот-вот взорвётся...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..original: Whaaat?! How can you be so calm? We have to do something!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..translation: Что-о-о?! Как ты можешь быть такой спокойной? Нужно что-то делать!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..original: Sure we do, but I think it's too late. Hahaha...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..translation: Конечно нужно, но, кажется, уже поздно. Ха-ха-ха...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..original: This is no time for laughter! Uwaaah, help!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..translation: Сейчас не время для смеха! Ух, помогите!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..original: Put in some green neutralizer! Quickly!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..translation: Добавьте зелёный нейтрализатор! Быстро!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..original: What?! O-okay! Hey, it's stopped!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..translation: Что?! Х-хорошо! Эй, остановилось!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..original: Phew, that was close. This one catches a lot of people off guard.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..translation: Уф, чуть не случилось беды. Многих это застает врасплох.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..original: Thank you so much. You literally saved us. You just turned up at the right time!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..translation: Большое спасибо. Ты буквально нас спасла. Как раз вовремя!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..original: Hehe, I was watching outside. I thought it was about time you blew up your cauldron!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..translation: Хе-хе, я наблюдала снаружи. Подумала, что вам как раз пора взорвать котёл!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..original: Gah, are we that predictable? Why do I feel so ashamed?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..translation: Ах, мы настолько предсказуемы? Почему так стыдно?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..original: Haha! I've got you in the palm of my hand. This is for you, then.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..translation: Ха-ха! Вы у меня как на ладони. Тогда вот это вам.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..original: A textbook? Wow, it's packed with detailed information!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..translation: Учебник? Ого, сколько подробной информации!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..original: That's right. It should contain all the data you need to proceed to the next level.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..translation: Верно. В нём должны быть все данные, нужные для перехода на следующий уровень.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..original: If you read all of that, your abilities could double!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..translation: Если прочитаете всё это, ваши способности могут удвоиться!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..original: D-Double? Are you sure?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..translation: У-удвоиться? Ты уверена?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..original: Oh, you doubt me? Then I'll give you a task. Make the item here and bring it to me.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..translation: О, сомневаетесь? Тогда дам вам задание. Сделайте предмет отсюда и принесите мне.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..original: Doing that should show you that this textbook is worth your time.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..translation: Так вы поймёте, что этот учебник стоит вашего времени.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..original: Hmm, okay. We'll give it a try.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..translation: Хм, ладно. Попробуем.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..original: Don't try, do! And don't make that cauldron explode again! Bye-bye.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..translation: Не пробуйте — сделайте! И не взрывайте этот котёл снова! Пока-пока.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..original: She came over just to bring us this book. She so different from Dad, I can't believe it!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..translation: Она пришла только чтобы принести нам эту книгу. Она так отличается от папы, не верится!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..original: Hahaha! He just leaves us to our devices, really...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..translation: Ха-ха-ха! Он и правда оставляет нас на произвол судьбы...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..original: Yeah. I'm so glad that she's a kind teacher! We have to work hard to keep her on our side!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..translation: Ага. Я так рада, что она добрая наставница! Нам нужно стараться, чтобы не разочаровать её!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..speaker: System
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..original: <CLEG>Ilmeria's Homework<CLNR> received.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..translation: <CLEG>Домашнее задание Ильмерии<CLNR> получено.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..original: Good, good. It looks like you've done a good job. Well done.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..translation: Хорошо, хорошо. Похоже, вы отлично справились. Отличная работа.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..original: How about that textbook? Did it help you?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..original: Yes, a lot! It was so easy to understand!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..translation: Да, очень! Его так легко понять!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..original: With all the images and diagrams I could read it too, no trouble!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..translation: С картинками и схемами я тоже смогла прочитать без проблем!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..original: You have great taste in textbooks, Ilmeria! Wherever did you find it?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..translation: У тебя отличный вкус к учебникам, Ильмерия! Где ты его нашла?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..original: Oh, I didn't buy it. I made it!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..translation: А, я его не покупала. Это моя собственная работа!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..original: What?! You made it yourself?! Your handwriting is amazing!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..translation: Что?! Ты сама его сделала?! У тебя потрясающий почерк!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..original: That's what you take away from that revelation? Well, I guess I'll take it.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..translation: Вот что вы вынесли из этого откровения? Ну, пожалуй, приму как комплимент.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..original: The textbook I used myself was really difficult. Very hard to decipher, just horrible.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..translation: Учебник, которым пользовалась я сама, был очень сложным. Трудно разобрать, просто ужас.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..original: So I decided, if I ever got students of my own, to make my own textbook for them.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..translation: Поэтому я решила: если когда-нибудь появятся свои ученики — сделаю для них собственный учебник.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..original: I really broke down everything I had trouble with myself, so it should be quite easy to follow!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..translation: Я подробно разобрала всё, с чем сама мучилась, так что следовать ему должно быть довольно легко!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..original: It was! Thank you so much for doing this for us!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..translation: Так и было! Огромное спасибо, что сделала это для нас!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..original: We'll keep it safe, we promise! Hey, we'll make it a family heirloom!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..translation: Мы сохраним его, обещаем! Эй, сделаем из него семейную реликвию!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..original: Y-You don't have to go that far! A bit of an exaggeration there!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..translation: В-вам не обязательно заходить так далеко! Это уже преувеличение!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..original: I hope it can be of help to you, though. It wasn't easy to make it, I can tell you that much!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..translation: Но надеюсь, он вам поможет. Сделать его было непросто, уж поверьте!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..original: Show me that all my hard work was worth it!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..translation: Покажите мне, что весь мой труд того стоил!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..original: We will! Oh, and do you want me to write a book report on it? I can do that, if you like!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..translation: Покажем! О, а хочешь, я напишу на него отзыв? Могу, если хочешь!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..original: Ah, no... That won't be necessary.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..original: Ah, I've got one request. Could you show me the textbook that you used?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..translation: Ах, у меня одна просьба. Можешь показать учебник, которым пользовалась ты?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..original: Uwah, look at you! Ilmeria said it was "hard to decipher" and "horrible"! You want to see that?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..translation: Ух ты, ну ты даёшь! Ильмерия сказала «трудно разобрать» и «ужас»! И ты хочешь это увидеть?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..original: No need to tease her. Curiosity is a good thing. If you want to have a look, I'll show it to you.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..translation: Не дразни её. Любопытство — это хорошо. Если хочешь посмотреть, покажу.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..original: Uwah, look at all that text! I can't tell what it's trying to say!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..translation: Ух ты, сколько текста! Совершенно не понять, о чём тут написано!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..original: Yes, reading this isn't easy. It's filled with stuffy old expressions, too.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..translation: Да, читать это непросто. Плюс полно занудных старых выражений.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..original: It's no good, I can't look at that! The person who wrote this must have been super strict!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..translation: Безнадёжно, я не могу на это смотреть! Тот, кто это написал, наверняка был очень строгим!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..original: I guess you could say that. A very particular person, one might say.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..translation: Можно и так сказать. Очень своеобразный человек, если угодно.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..original: Hold on. Do you know the person who wrote this?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..translation: Погоди. Ты знаешь того, кто это написал?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..original: Of course. That book was written by my father. Look at the cover.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..translation: Конечно. Эту книгу написал мой отец. Посмотрите на обложку.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..original: "Alfred Von Leinweber". The same surname as you, Ilmeria!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..translation: «Альфред фон Лейнвебер». Та же фамилия, что у тебя, Ильмерия!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..original: Hold on, Leinweber? How am I only just noticing this?!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..translation: Погоди, Лейнвебер? Как я только сейчас это заметила?!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..original: You don't mean the Leinwebers who are known as one of the three great houses of alchemy?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..translation: Ты из тех Лейнвеберов, которых знают как один из трёх великих домов алхимии?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..original: Yes, that's right. I'm his heir.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..translation: Да, верно. Я его наследница.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..original: Uwah! Even I've heard of them! I had no idea you were that incredible!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..translation: Ух! Даже я о них слышала! Я и не представляла, что ты такая невероятная!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..original: A super elite alchemist! Not someone we should just be chatting to like this!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..translation: Элитный алхимик! Не стоит просто так нам с тобой болтать!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..original: You dummy, it's fine! There's nothing different about me just because of my famous family.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..translation: Глупышки, всё в порядке! Из-за знаменитой семьи я ничуть не меняюсь.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..original: I'm your teacher, and you are my students. That isn't going to change.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..translation: Я ваша наставница, а вы мои ученицы. Это не изменится.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..original: So please, do try and keep up with me! I'm going to train you as hard as I can, you'll see!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..translation: Так что, пожалуйста, старайтесь не отставать! Я буду тренировать вас изо всех сил, вот увидите!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..original: Ilmeria! We'll follow you, as far as you'll lead us!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..translation: Ильмерия! Мы последуем за тобой, куда бы ты ни повела!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..original: To the ends of the earth! In the bath or the washroom!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..translation: Хоть на край земли! Хоть в ванную или в уборную!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..original: Y-You don't have to go that far! You need to learn some boundaries, you dummy!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..translation: Н-не нужно заходить так далеко! Должны же быть хоть какие-то границы, дурочки!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..original: Hmm, so if that's the case, the next material...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..translation: Хм, если так, то следующий материал...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..original: Uwah, another super difficult looking book! I can't believe you understand this, Ilmeria!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..translation: Ух, ещё одна суперсложная книга! Не могу поверить, что ты это понимаешь, Ильмерия!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..original: Waaaaaaah!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..translation: А-а-а-а!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..original: D-Don't sneak up like that! You surprised me!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..translation: Н-не подкрадывайтесь так! Вы меня напугали!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..original: S-Sorry... We did call you when we came in.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..translation: П-прости... Мы же позвали тебя, когда вошли.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..original: You just didn't react at all! What are you concentrating on so hard?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..translation: Ты просто никак не отреагировала! На чём ты так сосредоточена?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..original: Just my studies. I got my hands on a somewhat rare textbook.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..translation: Просто учёба. Мне попался довольно редкий учебник.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..original: Wow, you're studying? Being such a genius, I was sure you never have to study!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..translation: Ого, ты учишься? Будучи такой гениальной. Я была уверена, что тебе уже это не нужно!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..original: Of course I do! If I'm a genius at anything, it's working hard!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..translation: Конечно приходится! Если я в чём-то и гений — так это в упорном труде!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..original: Wow!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..translation: Ого!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..original: I know I said just studying isn't enough, but that doesn't mean you can skip studying altogether!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..translation: Я знаю, я говорила, что одной учёбы мало, но это не значит, что можно вообще не учиться!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..original: In order to not lose to Firis, and to be able to remain your teacher...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..translation: Чтобы не проиграть Фирис и остаться вашей наставницей...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..original: And, more than anything, to always be the very best, I have to work hard every single day!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..translation: И, прежде всего, чтобы всегда быть самой лучшей, мне нужно трудиться каждый день!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..original: I see. That stoic attitude is one of your greatest strengths, Ilmeria.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..translation: Понимаю. Эта твоя непоколебимость — одна из сильнейших твоих сторон, Ильмерия.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..original: Ah, I'm glad you understand. Perhaps you could take a page out of my book too?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..translation: Ах, рада, что понимаешь. Может, и вы возьмёте с меня пример?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..original: This, and this. How about this one, too?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..translation: Это, и это. А как насчёт вот этого?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..original: Hold on, Ilmeria? Why are you piling up all those books?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..translation: Погоди, Ильмерия? Зачем ты складываешь все эти книги?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..original: That's more than would fit in any box I could carry!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..translation: Это больше, чем поместится в любую коробку, которую я смогу унести!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..original: Ah, these books are your next homework. You need to read them all before tomorrow.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..translation: Ах, эти книги — ваше следующее домашнее задание. Нужно прочитать их все до завтра.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..original: Then I'm going to test you on them! Fail and I'll keep you back for more studying!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..translation: Потом я вас по ним проверю! Провалите — оставлю на дополнительные занятия!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..original: What?! What are we going to do, Lydie?!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..translation: Что?! Что будем делать, Лиди?!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..original: W-We can't read them, that's for sure! Promises with mom or not!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..translation: М-мы не сможем их прочитать, это точно! Обещания мы маме или нет!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..original: I was thinking the same thing. In that case, there's only one thing left to do! Run!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..translation: Я думала о том же. Тогда остаётся только одно! Бежать!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..original: Hey, girls! Gah, spineless! Both of you!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..translation: Эй, девочки! Ах, бесхребетные! Обе!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..original: Uwaaaaah?!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..translation: А-а-а?!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..original: W-What's wrong?! Why are you suddenly shouting like that?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..translation: Ч-что случилось?! Почему ты вдруг так кричишь?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..original: This! This here! It's cute! So cute!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..translation: Это! Вот это! Такое милое! Как мило!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..original: You're right! Is this yours, Ilmeria?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..translation: Ты права! Это твоё, Ильмерия?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..original: Yes. Do you have a problem with that?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..translation: Да. У вас с этим проблемы?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..original: No, no problem. I'm just surprised you like cute things.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..translation: Нет-нет, никаких. Просто удивлена, что тебе нравятся такие милые вещи.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..original: W-What?! I'm not that fond of them, not really!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..translation: Ч-что?! Мне они не особо нравятся, правда!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..original: Really? If I take a better look around this atelier, there's actually lots of cute stuff in here...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..translation: Правда? Если присмотреться к этому ателье — здесь полно милых вещиц...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..original: T-They were gifts. All of them! I didn't buy them myself.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..translation: Э-это были подарки. Все! Я сама их не покупала.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..original: Hmm? Hehehe... Let's see.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..translation: Хм? Хе-хе-хе... Посмотрим.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..original: Hey, Ilmeria... I really like this doll, do you think I could have it?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..translation: Эй, Ильмерия... Мне очень нравится эта кукла, полагаю, я могу её взять?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..original: Ugh?!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..translation: Ух?!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..original: If you don't actually like cute things, you don't mind if I take it, do you?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..translation: Если тебе на самом деле не нравятся милые вещи, ты же не против, если я её заберу?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..original: Ugh...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..translation: Ух...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..original: It's not a problem, right? Ilmeria! Please!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..translation: Это же не проблема, верно? Ильмерия! Пожалуйста!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..original: Uwaaaah! N-No! Chirpy is mine, and no one can take him!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..translation: А-а-а! Н-нет! Чирпи мой, и никто его не заберёт!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..original: C-Chirpy! Hahaha! Ilmeria, did you just say Chirpy?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..translation: Ч-Чирпи! Ха-ха-ха! Ильмерия, ты только что сказала «Чирпи»?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..original: D-Don't laugh! So what if I like cute things?!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..translation: Н-не смейся! Ну и что, что мне нравятся милые вещи?!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..original: You're the one who denied it! You could have just said so from the beginning...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..translation: Ты сама всё отрицала! Можно было просто сказать с самого начала...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..original: No, I mean...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..translation: Нет, я имею в виду...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..original: Having a teacher who likes cute things... That's not very cool, is it?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..translation: Наставница, которой нравятся милые вещи... Это же не очень круто, правда?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..original: Ah! So cute! Sue, I think Ilmeria is the cutest thing in here!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..translation: Ах! Как мило! Сью, по-моему, Ильмерия здесь самая милая!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..original: Yeah! I agree. My heart just skipped a beat! Ilmeria, you're so cute!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..translation: Ага! Согласна. У меня сердце екнуло! Ильмерия, ты такая милая!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..original: S-Stop that! Don't mock me! Gah, I didn't want you finding out about this!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..translation: П-прекратите! Не издевайтесь надо мной! Ах, я не хотела, чтобы вы об этом узнали!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..original: Please, will you forgive us? We'll tell you about a place that sells all sorts of cute things...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..translation: Пожалуйста, прости нас? Мы расскажем тебе о месте, где продают всякие милые штучки...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..original: Really?! Oh, darn it!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..translation: Правда?! Ох, чёрт!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..original: Oh! So cute... Ilmeria is so cute!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..translation: Ой! Такая милая... Ильмерия такая милая!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..original: Gah, I can't believe this. Getting teased by my own students! I'll remember this, both of you!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..translation: Ах, не верится. Меня дразнят собственные ученицы! Я это припомню, вам обеим!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..original: Hmm, what to do... Lydie is one thing, but Sue...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..translation: Хм, что делать... С Лиди одно, а со Сью...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..original: Ilmeria, what's up? Did you just say our names?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..translation: Ильмерия, что такое? Ты только что назвала наши имена?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..original: Oh, you heard that? I was just thinking about the best way to teach you.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..translation: О, вы услышали? Я как раз думала, как лучше вас учить.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..original: Thinking about the best way to help my students grow is a part of my job as your teacher, after all.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..translation: В конце концов, думать, как лучше помочь ученицам расти, — часть моей работы как вашей наставницы.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..original: Uwah! You're so incredible, Ilmeria, I don't know what to say...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..translation: Ух! Ты такая невероятная, Ильмерия, я даже не знаю, что сказать...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..original: Incredible, you say? Recently I've been thinking, actually, about what kind of teacher I should be.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..translation: Невероятная, говорите? В последнее время я как раз думала, какой наставницей мне быть.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..original: What kind?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..translation: Какой?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..original: Well, my teacher was also my father. He was very, very strict.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..translation: Ну, мой наставник был ещё и моим отцом. Он был очень, очень строгим.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..original: Of course, I improved and matured a lot, thanks to him. But it was also very difficult.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..translation: Конечно, благодаря ему я сильно выросла и повзрослела. Но это было и очень тяжело.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..original: So I've been trying to find an approach that differs from the one my father took.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..translation: Поэтому я старалась найти подход, отличный от отцовского.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..original: I see. I hadn't really considered the need to be a "kind" of teacher before.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..translation: Понимаю. Раньше я как-то не задумывалась о том, что наставнику нужен какой-то определённый... образ.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..original: Nor I, until now. What do you both think of me? Do you think I'm doing well as your teacher?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..translation: И я до сих пор. Что вы обе обо мне думаете? Хорошо ли я справляюсь как ваша наставница?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..speaker: Together
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..original: Of course!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..translation: Конечно!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..speaker: System
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..original: Of course!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..translation: Конечно!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..original: T-That was a little too smooth. You don't have to worry about my feelings...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..translation: Э-это было слишком гладко. Вам не нужно щадить мои чувства...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..original: We're not. You're so kind, and always listen to our problems.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..translation: Мы и не щадим. Ты такая добрая и всегда выслушиваешь наши проблемы.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..original: You explain things clearly, and help us with so much. You really are a great teacher!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..translation: Ты доходчиво всё объясняешь и так много нам помогаешь. Ты правда отличная наставница!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..original: Girls!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..translation: Девочки!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..original: Ah! And more importantly, you're so cute!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..translation: Ах! И что ещё важнее — ты такая милая!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..original: Hahaha! That's right! That's very important!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..translation: Ха-ха-ха! Верно! Это очень важно!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..original: H-Hey! Stop calling me cute! Don't pick on your teacher!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..translation: Э-эй! Перестаньте называть меня милой! Не придирайтесь к наставнице!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..original: Hehehe... You're even cuter when you're pouting!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..translation: Хе-хе-хе... Ты ещё милее, когда дуешься!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..original: You might be right, Sue. Hey, this feels more like we're becoming friends, doesn't it?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..translation: Пожалуй, ты права, Сью. Эй, кажется, мы становимся больше подругами, да?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..original: You continue to underestimate me, girls! I'm going to teach you how fearsome I am!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..translation: Вы продолжаете меня недооценивать, девочки! Я научу вас, какая я грозная!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..original: Both of you, stir that cauldron 1000 times each! 500 lap container marathon! Go, now!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..translation: Обе — мешайте этот котёл по тысяче раз каждая! И бегом марафон на пятьсот кругов вокруг склада! Живо!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..original: W-What?! That's not fair!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..translation: Ч-что?! Это нечестно!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..original: I think that's one of your flaws, Ilmeria!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..translation: По-моему, это один из твоих недостатков, Ильмерия!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..original: Silence! Students must listen to their teacher! Come on, move!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..translation: Тихо! Ученицы должны слушаться наставницу! Давайте, двигайтесь!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..original: Ah, we just got a bit carried away! We'll apologize! Forgive us!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..translation: Ах, мы просто немного увлеклись! Извини! Прости нас!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..original: Hehehe...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..translation: Хе-хе-хе...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..original: Ilmeria? Did something good happen? You look so happy!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..translation: Ильмерия? Случилось что-то хорошее? Ты выглядишь такой счастливой!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..original: Yes, actually. I got a letter from my parents. Do you want to take a look?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..translation: Да. Я получила письмо от родителей. Хотите взглянуть?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..original: Yes please! Is it alright? Let's have a look here...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..translation: Да, пожалуйста! Можно? Давай посмотрим...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..original: "Dearest Ilmeria. Thank you for sending the staff."
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..translation: «Дорогая Ильмерия. Спасибо, что прислала посох».

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..original: "I'm happy to see that you've improved again. Your mother is very proud too."
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..translation: «Я рад видеть, что ты снова стала лучше. Твоя мама тоже очень тобой гордится».

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..original: "As your teacher, as well as your father, I'm happy to see your growth."
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..translation: «Как твой наставник и как твой отец, я рад видеть твой рост».

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..original: "It can't be easy living in another country, but stay happy and do your best!"
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..translation: «Жить в другой стране нелегко, но оставайся счастливой и старайся изо всех сил!»

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..original: Hehe, what a lovely letter. I can see why you're so pleased!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..translation: Хе-хе, какое чудесное письмо. Понимаю, почему ты так рада!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..original: I know! I think recently I've started to understand how my father feels, too.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..translation: Знаю! Думаю, в последнее время я тоже начала понимать, что чувствует мой отец.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..original: When he talks about being happy to see his student grow.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..translation: Когда он говорит, что рад видеть, как растёт его ученица.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..original: After all, I feel the same thing, watching you two grow every day!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..translation: В конце концов, я чувствую то же самое, глядя, как вы двое растёте каждый день!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..original: Ilmeria!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..translation: Ильмерия!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..original: Girls, I want you to continue to work hard, in order to keep making me even happier!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..translation: Девочки, я хочу, чтобы вы продолжали стараться — и делали меня ещё счастливее!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..original: I'm not going to let you stay bottom tier alchemists forever, do you understand?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..translation: Я не позволю вам вечно оставаться алхимиками низшего уровня, понятно?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..original: Hahaha, leave it to us! We'll grow up so much that you won't be able to stop smiling!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..translation: Ха-ха-ха, оставь это нам! Мы так вырастем, что ты не сможешь перестать улыбаться!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..original: That's right! You just keep on watching us!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..translation: Верно! Только продолжай за нами наблюдать!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..original: Oh, I will. I'm going to watch every little thing that you do, trust me!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..translation: О, буду. Буду следить за каждой мелочью, вот увидите, поверьте!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..original: Hahaha! I bet you could do that, too, couldn't you... That's kind of scary!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..translation: Ха-ха-ха! Спорю, ты и правда так сможешь... Это немного пугает!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..original: Hehe. I am really looking forward to it.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..translation: Хе-хе. Я правда этого жду.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..original: That's it for today, then. Make sure you revise all of this!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..translation: Тогда на сегодня всё. Обязательно повторите всё это!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..original: We will! Thank you!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..translation: Обязательно! Спасибо!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..original: Thank you! Uwah, my head is splitting...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..translation: Спасибо! Ух, голова раскалывается...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..original: You're still not one for studying at a desk, are you Sue? Just relax, I'll get you some sugar!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..translation: Сью, ты по-прежнему не любишь учиться за столом? Расслабься, я принесу тебе сладости!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..original: Thank you... Uwah, I could use it!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..translation: Спасибо... Ух, мне бы это пригодилось!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..original: Ah, I'm alive again! If you feed me more sweet snacks, I might be able to study a bit more!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..translation: Ах, я снова жива! Если подкормишь меня ещё сладким, может, смогу ещё немного поучиться!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..original: Oh, you've done it now! I'm going to bury this room in candy, if that's what it takes!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..translation: О, ну всё, ты добилась своего! Я завалю эту комнату конфетами, если понадобится!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..original: Uwah! I want to eat them, but I don't want to study! What a bind to be in!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..translation: Ух! Хочу есть, но не хочу учиться! Вот так ловушка!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..original: You're just too honest, Sue! Can't you be a little more serious with your studies?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..translation: Ты слишком честная, Сью! Не можешь отнестись к учёбе чуть серьёзнее?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..original: I can't hear you! La la la! Tell me, though, isn't there some way to quickly get better at alchemy?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..translation: Я тебя не слышу! Ла-ла-ла! А скажи, нет ли способа быстро стать лучше в алхимии?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..original: I know that studying and practicing are important, but isn't there another way?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..translation: Я знаю, что учёба и практика важны, но нет ли другого пути?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..original: You could choose a rival? Someone to compete against? Like Firis is for me.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..translation: Можете выбрать соперницу? С кем соревноваться? Как Фирис для меня.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..original: I see. A rival! Our rival would be Lucia, maybe?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..translation: Понятно. Соперница! Может, нашей соперницей будет Люсия?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..original: Yes, that's a good choice. She's a skilled alchemist and she hates to lose.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..translation: Да, хороший выбор. Она умелый алхимик и ненавидит проигрывать.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..original: But then you sisters are a bit like rivals too, aren't you?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..translation: Но вы, сёстры, тоже немного соперницы, не так ли?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..original: Hey, you're right! We started out together, and I definitely don't want to lose, even to my sister!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..translation: Эй, ты права! Мы начинали вместе, и я точно не хочу проигрывать — даже сестре!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..original: Eh? Sue as a rival? Hmm, that doesn't really sound challenging...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..translation: Э? Сью как соперница? Хм, звучит не так уж сложно...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..original: What did you just say?! I can't ignore that, even from you!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..translation: Что ты только что сказала?! Этого я даже от тебя не стерплю!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..original: Hahaha, I'm sorry, I was just kidding. You're a powerful rival, Sue.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..translation: Ха-ха-ха, прости, я просто пошутила. Ты сильная соперница, Сью.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..original: The more rivals you have, the better. There's nothing wrong with some friendly competition.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..translation: Чем больше соперниц, тем лучше. В дружеском соперничестве нет ничего плохого.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..original: No problem. We'll be like you and Firis! Sometimes at each other's throats, sometimes all snuggly!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..translation: Без проблем. Будем как ты и Фирис! То глотки друг другу готовы перегрызть, то обнимаемся!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..original: Hey! We don't get "snuggly"!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..translation: Эй! Мы не «обнимаемся»!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..original: You don't? I've seen you looking pretty...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..translation: Не обнимаетесь? А я видела, как вы довольно...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..original: No, we don't! Never! Gah, you girls just love to mock me, don't you?!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..translation: Нет! Никогда! Ах, вы, девчонки, просто любите надо мной издеваться, да?!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..original: Wah, this is bad! She's going into Hardcore Master mode again!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..translation: Ого, плохо дело! Она снова входит в режим Суровой наставницы!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..original: Oh no, oh no... Run for it! See you later!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..translation: О нет, о нет... Бежим! До встречи!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..original: Those girls! I need to write "respect your teacher" on their faces in permanent ink...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..translation: Эти девочки! Напишу вам на лицах «уважай наставницу» несмываемыми чернилами...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..original: I'm not getting all snuggly, whatever that means anyway! I'm not, right?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..translation: Я не собираюсь ни с кем мило обниматься, что бы это ни значило! Не собираюсь, верно?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..original: Hello! ...Hm?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..translation: Привет! ...Хм?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..original: So I'm trying to do something about how much Sue hates studying...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..translation: Так вот, я пытаюсь что-то сделать с тем, как сильно Сью ненавидит учёбу...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..original: Hmm, I see. What about you, Firis? Did you have a time when you didn't like studying?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..translation: Хм, понятно. А ты, Фирис? Было ли у тебя время, когда тебе не нравилось учиться?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..original: What? I don't think we ever really sat down and read books, did we?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..translation: Что? По-моему, мы никогда особо не садились за книги, не так ли?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..original: Good point... Sophie has quite a unique method of teaching.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..translation: Дельное замечание... У Софи довольно своеобразный метод преподавания.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..original: T-That's not true! All right, well, maybe it is... Sorry I wasn't a more orthodox teacher!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..translation: Э-это неправда! Ладно, ну, может быть... Жаль, что я не была более классической наставницей!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..original: Ah, no need to apologize! You're a practical teacher, that's all! That's fine too, hahaha!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..translation: Ах, не надо извиняться! Ты практичная наставница, вот и всё! Это тоже хорошо, ха-ха-ха!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..original: I didn't dislike it, either. It was great fun, learning from you!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..translation: Я тоже не была против. Было очень весело учиться у тебя!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..original: Firis...!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..translation: Фирис...!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..original: Fun, did you say?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..translation: Весело, говоришь?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..original: Hehe, what's all this chatter? Sounds like you're having fun!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..translation: Хе-хе, что за болтовня? Похоже, вам весело!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..original: We are having a little meeting of teachers and students, talking about the best ways to teach.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..translation: У нас небольшое собрание наставников и учеников — обсуждаем лучшие способы преподавания.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..original: Wah, you do that too? So that stuff you were just talking about...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..translation: Ого, вы тоже так делаете? Значит, то, о чём вы только что говорили...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..original: Hehehe. I'm surprised to hear your dislike studying, Sue. Ilmeria has been telling us all about it!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..translation: Хе-хе-хе. Удивлена узнать, что ты не любишь учиться, Сью. Ильмерия нам всё рассказала!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..original: Ah, well... I'm sorry, Ilmeria...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..translation: Ах, ну... Прости, Ильмерия...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..original: Ilmeria?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..translation: Ильмерия?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..original: What? Ah, sorry... I wasn't listening.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..translation: Что? Ах, прости... Я не слушала.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..original: How about we close this meeting and eat? You two can join us, if you like.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..translation: Как насчёт закрыть собрание и поесть? Вы двое можете присоединиться, если хотите.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..original: Ah, would that be alright? Great!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..translation: Ах, можно? Отлично!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..original: Please come again, any time!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..translation: Приходите снова в любое время!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..original: Ilmeria, can I ask? Sorry if I'm wrong about this, but you look a bit upset about something...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..translation: Ильмерия, можно спросить? Извини, если ошибаюсь, но ты выглядишь немного расстроенной...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..original: I noticed that as well... Is it about me?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..translation: Я тоже заметила... Это из-за меня?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..original: No, it's not that. Not entirely. It's just that Sophie and Firis are so dazzling...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..translation: Нет, не в этом дело. Не совсем. Просто Софи и Фирис такие ослепительные...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..original: Firis talked about how much fun it was to learn from Sophie.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..translation: Фирис рассказывала, как весело было учиться у Софи.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..original: I know the way I teach is a bit boring... I've just been thinking about that.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..translation: Я знаю, что мой способ преподавания немного скучный... Вот об этом и думала.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..original: That maybe it would have been better if someone else had become your teacher...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..translation: Что, может, было бы лучше, если бы вашей наставницей стала другая...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..original: That's... !
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..translation: Это... !

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..original: Sorry. I'm going home now. Good-bye, girls.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..translation: Простите. Я пойду домой. До свидания, девочки.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..original: Why would she say that?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..translation: Зачем ей так говорить?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..original: It's my fault... Because I hate studying so much.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..translation: Это моя вина... Потому что я так ненавижу учиться.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..original: I know I'm not the best student, but I love being taught by her! Ah, I'm sorry, Ilmeria!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..translation: Я знаю, что я не лучшая ученица, но мне нравится, когда она меня учит! Ах, прости, Ильмерия!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..original: Sue!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..translation: Сью!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..original: Hello! ...Hm?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..translation: Привет! ...Хм?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..original: So I'm trying to do something about how much Sue hates studying...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..translation: Так вот, я пытаюсь что-то сделать с тем, как сильно Сью ненавидит учёбу...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..original: Hmm, I see. What about you, Firis? Did you have a time when you didn't like studying?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..translation: Хм, понятно. А ты, Фирис? Было ли у тебя время, когда тебе не нравилось учиться?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..original: What? I don't think we ever really sat down and read books, did we?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..translation: Что? По-моему, мы никогда особо не садились за книги, правда?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..original: Good point... Sophie has quite a unique method of teaching.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..translation: Дельное замечание... У Софи довольно своеобразный метод преподавания.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..original: T-That's not true! All right, well, maybe it is... Sorry I wasn't a more orthodox teacher!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..translation: Э-это неправда! Ладно, ну, может быть... Жаль, что я не была более классической наставницей!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..original: Ah, no need to apologize! You're a practical teacher, that's all! That's fine too, hahaha!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..translation: Ах, не надо извиняться! Ты практичная наставница, вот и всё! Это тоже хорошо, ха-ха-ха!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..original: I didn't dislike it, either. It was great fun, learning from you!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..translation: Я тоже не была против. Было очень весело учиться у тебя!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..original: Firis...!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..translation: Фирис...!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..original: Fun, did you say?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..translation: Весело, говоришь?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..original: Hehe, what's all this chatter? Sounds like you're having fun!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..translation: Хе-хе, что за болтовня? Похоже, вам весело!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..original: We are having a little meeting of teachers and students, talking about the best ways to teach.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..translation: У нас небольшое собрание наставников и учеников — обсуждаем лучшие способы преподавания.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..original: Wah, you do that too? So that stuff you were just talking about...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..translation: Ого, вы тоже так делаете? Значит, то, о чём вы только что говорили...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..original: Hehehe. I'm surprised to hear your dislike studying, Sue. Ilmeria has been telling us all about it!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..translation: Хе-хе-хе. Удивлена узнать, что ты не любишь учиться, Сью. Ильмерия нам всё рассказала!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..original: Ah, well... I'm sorry, Ilmeria...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..translation: Ах, ну... Прости, Ильмерия...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..original: Ilmeria?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..translation: Ильмерия?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..original: What? Ah, sorry... I wasn't listening.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..translation: Что? Ах, прости... Я не слушала.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..original: How about we close this meeting and eat? You two can join us, if you like.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..translation: Как насчёт закрыть собрание и поесть? Вы двое можете присоединиться, если хотите.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..original: Ah, would that be alright? Great!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..translation: Ах, можно? Отлично!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..original: Please come again, any time!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..translation: Приходите снова в любое время!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..original: Ilmeria, can I ask? Sorry if I'm wrong about this, but you look a bit upset about something...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..translation: Ильмерия, можно спросить? Извини, если ошибаюсь, но ты выглядишь немного расстроенной...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..original: I noticed that as well... Is it about me?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..translation: Я тоже заметила... Это из-за меня?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..original: No, it's not that. Not entirely. It's just that Sophie and Firis are so dazzling...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..translation: Нет, не в этом дело. Не совсем. Просто Софи и Фирис такие ослепительные...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..original: Firis talked about how much fun it was to learn from Sophie.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..translation: Фирис рассказывала, как весело было учиться у Софи.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..original: I know the way I teach is a bit boring... I've just been thinking about that.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..translation: Я знаю, что мой способ преподавания немного скучный... Вот об этом и думала.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..original: That maybe it would have been better if someone else had become your teacher...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..translation: Что, может, было бы лучше, если бы вашей наставницей стала другая...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..original: That's... !
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..translation: Это... !

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..original: Sorry. I'm going home now. Good-bye, girls.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..translation: Простите. Я пойду домой. До свидания, девочки.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..original: Why would she say that?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..translation: Зачем ей так говорить?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..original: It's my fault... Because I hate studying so much.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..translation: Это моя вина... Потому что я так ненавижу учиться.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..original: I know I'm not the best student, but I love being taught by her! Ah, I'm sorry, Ilmeria!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..translation: Я знаю, что я не лучшая ученица, но мне нравится, когда она меня учит! Ах, прости, Ильмерия!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..original: Sue!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..translation: Сью!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..original: No... I'm not going to lose!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..translation: Нет... Я не проиграю!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..original: S-Sue, are you still reading? It's been over an hour!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..translation: С-Сью, ты всё ещё читаешь? Уже больше часа!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..original: You'll give yourself a fever and collapse, pushing yourself so! Stop it, Sue!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..translation: Ты доведёшь себя до лихорадки и упадёшь в обморок, если будешь так себя перенапрягать! Прекрати, Сью!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..original: Hey, that's just mean. It will take more than an hour to make me collapse!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..translation: Эй, это подло. Чтобы я упала в обморок, часа мало!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..original: I guess it might, but what's brought this on so suddenly?
